dentist.name: Dr. Aria Sen
dentist.introduction: “Dentistry is not merely about restoring tooth structure—it is about restoring peace of mind, ease of conversation, and the effortless confidence to smile without second thought.”
extendedBio: Dr. Aria Sen completed her advanced residency in Prosthodontics and Implant Dentistry, followed by clinical fellowships in minimally invasive biomimetic restorations.

With over fifteen years of focused clinical practice, she is committed to patient education, conservative treatment modalities, and the thoughtful integration of 3D digital planning into everyday care.
Dr. Sen lectures on digital restorative workflows and believes that the foundation of exceptional clinical outcomes begins with an unhurried, empathetic diagnostic conversation.
dentist.quote: Every patient brings a unique biological and aesthetic story. Our responsibility is to listen first, inform with clarity, and execute with quiet perfection.

about.headline: A sanctuary for oral health where clinical mastery meets quiet empathy.
paragraphs: At Aura Dental Atelier, we have designed every detail of the patient journey to eliminate the anxiety traditionally associated with dental visits. From sound-dampened private suites to warm ambient lighting, our space encourages relaxation from the moment you arrive.

We practice biomimetic and minimally invasive dentistry. This means we prioritize preserving your natural tooth structure whenever possible, utilizing advanced adhesive ceramics and biological principles that replicate the biomechanical strength of natural enamel.
No rushed consultations. No hidden treatment tiers. You receive a complete digital record of your diagnostic scans, accompanied by transparent, straightforward explanations of every viable option.

philosophy.description: We treat healthy tooth structure as irreplaceable, favoring micro-conservative preparations over aggressive crown removals.

services.title: Comprehensive Preventive Care
services.tagline: Systematic oral health evaluations and guided biofilm therapy.
services.shortDescription: Gentle airflow biofilm removal, digital occlusal assessments, and remineralization therapies tailored to your oral microbiome.
services.fullDescription: Routine preventive visits at Aura Dental go beyond basic scaling. We utilize gentle warm-water airflow technology to remove subgingival biofilm without scraping enamel. Every visit includes low-dose digital diagnostics, periodontal risk mapping, and personalized dietary guidance to protect your natural dentition for life.
services.recommendedFor: Adults and adolescents seeking gentle, proactive oral wellness maintenance.

services.title: Biomimetic Restorative Dentistry
services.tagline: Restoring natural tooth biomechanics through micro-layering ceramics.
services.shortDescription: Micro-hybrid composites and CAD/CAM ceramic onlays engineered to mimic the flexure and luminescence of natural dentin.
services.fullDescription: Traditional dentistry often grinds down substantial healthy tooth structure to seat full crowns. Biomimetic dentistry changes this by bonding custom-milled porcelain onlays and inlays exclusively to damaged zones. This preserves the maximum possible natural tooth vitality and prevents unnecessary root canal treatments.
features: Dentin sealing protocols under dental dam isolation
High-definition shade matching with cross-polarized photography
services.recommendedFor: Patients with worn fillings, cracked cusps, or localized structural decay.

services.title: Aesthetic Smile Harmonization
services.tagline: Custom porcelain veneers and subtle architectural smile design.
services.shortDescription: Ultra-thin ceramic veneers, digital smile design previews, and micro-aesthetic contouring for natural, understated elegance.
services.fullDescription: We do not believe in monochromatic, overly bulky veneers. Dr. Sen designs each porcelain laminate with individualized optical translucency, micro-texture, and incisal halos that complement your facial symmetry and natural lip dynamics. Test your new smile with a live intraoral mock-up prior to any final fabrication.
features: 3D digital smile simulation and physical try-in mock-up
Hand-layered feldspathic and lithium disilicate ceramics
Minimally invasive or non-prep veneer techniques
services.recommendedFor: Individuals seeking natural aesthetic enhancement, diastema closure, or color correction.

services.title: Precision Implantology & Replacement
services.tagline: Digitally guided implant placement for permanent, lifelike stability.
services.shortDescription: CBCT-guided titanium and zirconia implants with screw-retained ceramic crowns that look, feel, and function like natural roots.
services.fullDescription: Losing a tooth shouldn't compromise your surrounding teeth or facial bone volume. Using 3D computer-guided surgical guides, our implant placement is minimally invasive, highly predictable, and engineered for long-term osseointegration and gingival harmony.
features: Biocompatible titanium and metal-free ceramic implants
Immediate temporary crowns for aesthetic zones
services.recommendedFor: Patients needing single tooth replacement, bridge alternatives, or complete arch stability.

services.title: Microscopic Endodontic Therapy
services.tagline: High-magnification root canal preservation with sonic irrigation.
services.shortDescription: Preserving deeply compromised teeth through operating microscope visualization and warm bioceramic sealers.
services.fullDescription: Modern endodontics should never be traumatic. With Zeiss clinical operating microscopes magnifying canal anatomy up to 20x, we can locate micro-canals and cleanse infections with extreme precision. Bioceramic root filling materials ensure long-term sterile sealing and rapid tissue healing.
services.recommendedFor: Acute dental pain, pulpitis, deep infections, or complex trauma management.

services.title: Clear Aligner Orthodontics
services.tagline: Discreet, digital tooth realignment for balanced bite kinematics.
services.shortDescription: Custom-designed transparent aligners that gently guide teeth into optimal alignment and occlusal balance.
services.fullDescription: Straightening teeth is as much about joint health and wear prevention as it is about aesthetics. With 3D digital treatment simulations, you can visualize the step-by-step movement of your teeth and enjoy removable, virtually invisible aligners that fit your professional lifestyle.
features: Intraoral digital scan with instant outcome simulation
Periodic remote monitoring and check-in options
services.recommendedFor: Adults and professionals looking to correct crowding, spacing, or bite discrepancies.

specializations.title: Full-Arch Occlusal Rehabilitation
specializations.tagline: Rebuilding collapsed bites, worn dentition, and TMJ equilibrium.
specializations.description: For patients suffering from chronic grinding, severe enamel erosion, or missing teeth that have shifted jaw alignment. We conduct thorough digital jaw tracking and kinesiographic analysis to systematically restore chewing comfort and facial height.
highlights: Comprehensive TMJ and muscle palpation evaluation
Deprogramming splints to find physiologic centric relation
Phased restorative progression using bonded overlays

specializations.title: Micro-Layered Biomimetic Veneers
specializations.tagline: Artisanal ceramic craftsmanship with negligible enamel reduction.
specializations.description: Unlike standardized laboratory crowns, our micro-veneers are individually hand-characterized by master ceramists to match internal tooth dentin lobes, subtle incisal translucency, and natural light reflection under varying lighting environments.
highlights: High-definition studio portraiture and shade mapping
Multi-phase dry and wet try-in pastes for exact color verification
suitableFor: Chipped incisal edges requiring durable aesthetic restoration

specializations.title: Dental Anxiety & Comfort Protocols
specializations.tagline: A gentle, respectful approach for patients with dental apprehension.
specializations.description: We understand that dental phobia is real and valid. We offer step-by-step control signals, buffered warm local anesthesia that eliminates the sting, noise-cancelling acoustic headsets, and unhurried pacing with zero pressure.
highlights: Patient-controlled pause hand signals at any second
Buffered anesthetic solutions delivered at body temperature
Private treatment suites with dedicated air purification
suitableFor: Patients returning to dental care after extended intervals

technology.headline: Advanced technology serving precision, safety, and transparency.
technology.description: We invest in modern digital equipment not for show, but to make your diagnostics safer, your treatment more accurate, and your time in the chair as efficient and comfortable as possible.

items.title: 3D Optical Intraoral Scanner
items.subtitle: Zero goop, instant 3D models
items.description: High-speed laser scanning captures tens of thousands of data points per second, generating a photorealistic 3D map of your teeth and gums without silicone impression trays.
items.patientBenefit: Comfortable, accurate, and allows immediate visual review of your oral architecture on an overhead 4K display.

items.title: Ultra Low-Dose 3D CBCT Imaging
items.subtitle: Sub-millimeter anatomical insight
items.description: Our specialized cone beam computed tomography system captures volumetric 3D bone and nerve maps with up to 80% lower radiation exposure than traditional medical CT scans.
items.patientBenefit: Precise implant placement and diagnosis of hidden infections without unnecessary radiation exposure.

items.title: Airflow Guided Biofilm Therapy
items.subtitle: Gentle, non-abrasive prophylaxis
items.description: A micro-fine spray of warm water and erythritol powder gently dissolves plaque and biofilm from teeth, restorations, and implants without metal scraping or enamel abrasion.
items.patientBenefit: A warm, painless cleaning experience that leaves teeth polished and gums invigorated.

items.title: Zeiss Surgical Operating Microscopes
items.subtitle: Illumination and 20x magnification
items.description: Surgical optics provide shadow-free coaxial illumination and up to twenty times magnification, allowing our clinicians to identify micro-fractures invisible to the naked eye.
items.patientBenefit: Conservative micro-dentistry that saves natural tooth structure and ensures watertight margins.

benefits.headline: Four guiding principles that shape every patient interaction.
benefits.description: We built our practice on the values we would expect for our own families. Here is what you can rely on at every appointment.

items.title: We Listen First
items.description: Before any instruments are touched, we sit down to hear your goals, previous experiences, and any apprehensions you may have.
items.detail: Unhurried 45-minute initial consultations ensure your perspective is the cornerstone of our treatment plan.

items.title: We Explain Clearly
items.description: We show you direct high-resolution photographs and 3D scans so you understand the reason behind every recommendation.
items.detail: No medical jargon or opaque estimates. You receive a structured, written plan with clear timelines.

items.title: We Preserve Nature
items.description: Natural enamel is a biological marvel. We utilize adhesive biomimetic techniques to save tooth structure whenever possible.
items.detail: Conservative micro-preparations rather than invasive grinding for full crowns.

items.title: We Stay Connected
items.description: Our care doesn't end when you leave the chair. Our concierge team follows up after procedures to ensure comfortable healing.
items.detail: Direct emergency contact line for post-operative questions and continuous peace of mind.

faqs.question: What happens during my first visit to Aura Dental Atelier?
faqs.answer: Your initial visit is a comprehensive, unhurried 45 to 60-minute evaluation. We begin with a relaxed conversation about your dental history and goals, followed by ultra-low-dose digital radiographs, a 3D intraoral scan, and high-definition photography. Dr. Sen will review these scans with you on-screen and develop a clear, personalized roadmap for your oral health.

faqs.question: What is Biomimetic Dentistry and how is it different from traditional dentistry?
faqs.answer: Biomimetic dentistry means 'mimicking biology.' Instead of aggressive tooth grinding to fit standardized metal-ceramic crowns, we use advanced adhesive bonding and custom-milled ceramics that replicate the natural strength, flexibility, and thermal expansion of real teeth. This preserves up to 70% more natural tooth structure and minimizes the risk of nerve damage.

faqs.question: I experience significant dental anxiety. How do you accommodate nervous patients?
faqs.answer: We prioritize your physical and emotional comfort. You have complete control: we agree on a hand signal that pauses treatment instantly. We utilize buffered, body-temperature local anesthetics so you don't feel a sharp sting, provide noise-cancelling headphones, and never rush a procedure.

faqs.question: How do you handle dental emergencies outside standard operating hours?
faqs.answer: We maintain a dedicated emergency telephone line for patients of record experiencing acute pain, swelling, or dental trauma. When possible, we arrange same-day priority appointments to stabilize your condition and restore comfort promptly.

faqs.question: How do appointment reservations and payment transparency work?
faqs.answer: We believe in complete financial transparency. Before commencing any treatment beyond your initial diagnosis, you will receive an itemized treatment estimate detailing each phase, material, and cost. We accept all major digital payment methods and credit options.
